name: aback-ui
description: The building blocks behind better applications.

scripts.build: bun run build:ui && bun run build:cli && bun run build:registry && bun run --filter @aback-ui/docs build
scripts.test: bun --filter @aback-ui/ui test && bun --filter @aback-ui/cli test && bun --filter @aback-ui/docs test
scripts.typecheck: bun --filter @aback-ui/cli typecheck && bun --filter @aback-ui/ui typecheck && bun --filter @aback-ui/docs typecheck
scripts.check: bun run typecheck && bun run lint && bun run test && bun run check:registry && bun run test:consumer
